where: DESAT individual static reverse rating (Prior concrete defect corrected)
finding: lowest-cost path: Keep 2 x BYG23T in current PV/PCS; no balancing network added for the defined static envelope. | open validation: Qualify low-current Vf, dynamic sharing/recovery, noise immunity and fault timing.
recommendation: No blind waiver of repetitive overstress or device short-circuit survival.
closure: D-081 verified by the reviewer at BOM level (12 / 16 / 24 / 32 BYG23T on PCS-PWR / PCS-PWR-4W / PV-PWR / PV-PWR-4, two per channel) and by his own arithmetic (6.415-9.365 V window; 150 V margin at the 1150 V design envelope); no balancing network, no third diode. Open qualification (not a defect): the low-current V_F interval (ASSUMED below 0.1 A), dynamic sharing and recovery, noise immunity and fault timing - entries Q-01..Q-03 of the qualification plan (D-082).

where: Battery-less link and cable interface (Source/model correction confirmed; physical gate remains)
finding: lowest-cost path: Keep 750/755 V defaults, 782 V PV clamp and specified harness. | open validation: Coupled converter peaks, unequal runs, production harness and on-target enforcement not independently validated.
evidence: CODE-VERIFIED; INDEPENDENTLY CALCULATED; ACTUALLY SIMULATED (passive network only)
recommendation: Do not publish 846/909 V model boundaries as ratings.
closure: D-081's window verified (782 x 1.0057^2 = 790.9 V permissive; 135 A x 12.6 mOhm = 1.70 V; (746.4 + 1.70) / (1 - 0.0057) = 752.4 V -> 755 V); the reviewer's 48 passive cable simulations and 24 two-run equivalence checks confirm the CableBus equations (charge and energy conserved; a negative-resistance mutation rejected). Physical gate: the coupled converter peaks (887 / 914 V), unequal runs, the production harness and the on-target enforcement - Q-04..Q-06 (D-082). The 846 / 909 V model validities stay unpublished as ratings.

where: Semiconductor grades and sourcing (Previous grade-map correction retained)
finding: lowest-cost path: Pool tested parts into matched grades; supplier bin or qualified alternate only where lifecycle economics justify it. | open validation: Hot resistance distribution, dynamic sharing, reliability evidence and SC survival.
recommendation: Normal-power derating does not substitute for SC evidence.
closure: The two-grade policy (D-080 / D-081) retained: pool measured devices into matched grades; the supplier bin or a qualified alternate only where lifecycle economics justify it; the 124.57 kW grade-B statement verified. Gates: hot R_DS(on) distribution, dynamic sharing, reliability evidence and the selected-device short-circuit survival (2.03 us / 0.80 J requested, not demonstrated) - Q-10..Q-12 (D-082); normal-power derating is no substitute for the SC evidence.
